subject.title: fix(agent): stale replies after queued user turns

question: For the stale queued/orphaned user-turn class tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76888, should OpenClaw preserve the older user turn as context-only, drop provenance-classified internal orphan turns, or combine both behaviors before merge?
rationale: Both open repair candidates target the same user-visible stale-reply problem but encode different session-state semantics, and green tests cannot decide which behavior maintainers want as the product contract.

options.title: Land preserve-as-context repair
options.body: Accept this PR's metadata-hidden orphan repair as the canonical fix for the narrow issue, then treat internal provenance dropping as a separate follow-up if still needed.

options.title: Combine before merge
options.body: Ask for a combined patch that walks past metadata and also drops only provenance-classified internal orphan leaves before landing.

options.title: Prefer internal-drop semantics
options.body: Supersede this PR in favor of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96533 if maintainers decide stale internal handoffs are the canonical root cause.

recommendation.title: Land preserve-as-context repair
recommendation.body: Accept this PR's metadata-hidden orphan repair as the canonical fix for the narrow issue, then treat internal provenance dropping as a separate follow-up if still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The active queued-user prompt preservation behavior appears to originate from vincentkoc's prior merged work and current main blame points to the same area.
